title: Mini Smart Parking Guide
detail:
Dilnaz, Aruana, Madina and Alnur
AI Fundamentals final project
note: Problem statement and objectives: begin the two-minute introduction. Explain that the application is a simulation.

title: The parking problem
body:
A nearby space may be occupied.
A short route may be blocked.
detail: Objective: combine noisy sensor readings with a legal route and a reasoned next action.
note: Explain the practical problem without claiming measured savings. State that sensors and rewards are assumptions.

title: Three course topics
body:
BFS: shortest path on an unweighted grid
Bayesian inference: occupancy from a noisy reading
Value Iteration: action choice over future outcomes
detail: Course alignment: Week 2, Week 6 and Week 5
note: Spend about two minutes on algorithms across this slide and the next. These are distinct course topics.

title: A decision you can inspect
body:
40% prior becomes 75% after an alert.
No alert gives 7.7% occupancy.
The MDP can Drive, Check, Skip or Exit.
detail: 606 planning states. Discount 0.95. One recheck per candidate. Beliefs rounded to 1%.
note: Explain Bayes: 0.36/0.48=0.75. Explain Bellman backups, transition probabilities and why this is model-based planning rather than learned Q-learning.

title: Live demonstration
body:
Original: B in 6 steps
All clear: A in 4 steps
Only C clear: C in 8 steps
All alerts: recheck before driving
detail: Then block the exit, remove an obstacle and export a scenario.
note: Use the live application for three to five minutes. Do not promise that every alert means occupancy. Show calculation values and recheck controls.

title: Tests and evidence
body:
20 automated tests passed
152 prior and signal combinations
300 shortest-path comparisons on 100 maps
detail: Analytical Bayes checks, Bellman consistency, route safety and recheck outcomes.
note: Run node tests/run.js. The map comparison uses an independent repeated-relaxation oracle and seed 12345. Synthetic tests do not establish real-world sensor accuracy.

title: Scope and responsibility
body:
Synthetic sensor readings
Approximate belief-state planning
Shared team review with declared AI assistance
note: Limitations include conditional independence, fixed candidate order and distances measured from the entrance. All members should be ready for individual questions. ChatGPT substantially assisted the project.
